Let us defeat the enemies!

780020:
[Techniques]

780021:
Each use of a Technique
{8081:07}consumes GP (Gran Points){/color}.

GP {8081:07}recovers over time{/color} or when you
{8081:07}land normal attacks{/color}.

Combine normal attacks and Techniques
to fight effectively.
780022:
[Chain]

{8081:07}Hit enemies within a set time{/color} to
{8081:07}build up your Chain count{/color}.

Gauge at the top of the screen fills up.

780025:

longer act.
780026:
If you are incapacitated, you can
{8081:07}use a Scape Doll to revive{/color}.

the quest and takes you back to base.
780027:
{8081:07}Party members{/color} who are incapacitated
{8081:07}revive automatically after a while{/color}.

780028:

[Types of Status Ailments]

[Bind]

780030:
[Infection]
You take damage over time from a disease

Wind, Light, Dark, or all elements.
780031:
[Gran Link]

Gran Link is a technique that uses a {8081:07}Pile

Gigantes captured with Gran Link can be
brought back to your base.
780032:
[Performing a Gran Link]

{8081:07}use the Ignition skill from your Subpalette

[Setting Ignition]

{8081:07}set the Ignition skill in your Subpalette.{/color}

[Equip Subpalette], choose the palette to
place it in, and set Ignition there.
780034:
[Storage]

You can deposit items in Storage.

If you obtain an item while your Item Pack
(the items you carry) is at its 200-item
limit, it is sent to Storage automatically.

more than the limit.

If you obtain an item while Storage is at its

Storage automatically.

you cannot access the Quest Gate or shops.

780037:
[Just Guard]

A skill that triggers a Just Guard when you
{8081:07}Guard with good timing just before an
enemy attack hits.{/color}

{8081:07}deals counter damage to nearby enemies.{/color}
It also consumes no GP (Gran Points).
780039:
[Hunter]

Hunters are a combat type specializing in
{8081:07}close-range attacks.{/color}

They master the striking weapons: {8081:07}Swords,
Partisans, Double Sabers, and Knuckles.{/color}

The Hunter's evasive action, "Step," dodges
swiftly with minimal movement.
780041:
[Over-the-Shoulder View]

Over-the-shoulder view is a {8081:07}camera mode for
shooting weapons.{/color}

Use {8099:66} to aim manually.

more precisely at the spot you want to hit.
780044:
[Gran Arts/Techniques]

{8081:07}Gran Arts{/color} are powerful attacks that

There are many kinds of Gran Arts, each with
its own range and element.

Press {8099:74} to unleash the {8081:07}Gran Arts

{8081:07}Force and Buster Techniques{/color} are cast by
{8081:07}holding{/color} {8099:74}{8081:07} to charge.{/color}
780046:
[Camera Controls]

Use {8099:66} to {8081:07}look around.{/color}

press {8099:07}.

[Settings] > [Camera Settings]
in the Main Menu.
780047:
A successful Just Attack deals
heavy damage.

It also makes enemies react more strongly
when hit.

Make good use of it together with Gran Arts,
Charged Techniques, and more.
780048:
[Subpalette]

The Subpalette is the icon palette shown at
the bottom and right of the screen.

{8081:07}Touch an icon{/color} to
{8081:07}use an item.{/color}

{8081:07}Techniques activate when you touch and

780050:
{8081:07}Red guide icons{/color} appear where the story
moves forward.

If you get lost, look for a red guide icon.
780051:
[Moving Shot]

With {8081:07}Assault Rifles and some Gran Arts{/color},
you can use "{8081:07}Moving Shot{/color}" to
{8081:07}fire while moving.{/color}

dodging enemy attacks.
780052:
Moving Shot scatters your shots more than
normal firing does.

For accurate shots, stop and attack; use
Moving Shot when fighting while dodging
enemy attacks.
780054:
The skill "{8081:07}Armament: Pile{/color}," earned by
leveling up Buster, {8081:07}lets other classes
equip Piles too.{/color}

{8081:07}Lutina and the others also use Piles.{/color}
When another party member drives in a stake,
you can also {8081:07}capture the Gigantes{/color} by
using "{8081:07}Ignition{/color}."
780055:
Quests on {8081:07}Hard{/color} difficulty have been added.

Hard has stronger enemies, but you can
{8081:07}get better materials{/color} not found on Normal.

Gear up and take on the challenge!

780056:
Quests on {8081:07}Very Hard{/color} difficulty have been
added.

Very Hard is even tougher than Hard.
Enemies are stronger still, but you can
{8081:07}get better materials{/color} not found on Hard.

Raise your level, gear up, and take it on!
780057:
[Halo]

The Halo is a long-range technique weapon

Press {8099:74} to {8081:07}deploy a "Ring Field" in

780058:
[Ring Field]

When fighting huge Gigantes, use the
"Ring Field" as a foothold.

{8081:07}With a Halo equipped, press {/color}{8099:74}{8081:07} to deploy

780060:
[Pile]

The Pile is a weapon developed for fighting
Gigantes.

{8081:07}fires stakes at distant targets.{/color}

780061:
From now on, you can act freely toward your
goal: "Escape the Planet."

Choose which current problem to solve first,
or strengthen your equipment before that -
do whatever you think is best.

Everything you do will, in time, lead you
to "Escape the Planet."
780062:
[Boosted Enemies]

Rarely, you will meet enemies whose
abilities have been boosted.

Boosted enemies are stronger and more

them earns {8081:07}more EXP and better items{/color}.

780065:
[Settings/Help]

In Settings/Help, you can change game
settings, review tutorials, and more.
780066:

{8081:07}multiplayer games with other players{/color}.

After confirming a quest, {8081:07}choose the party

780073:

Set learned skills on the Skill Board to

[Skill Board Expansion]

[Passwords]

780079:

[Shops]

You can develop {8081:07}shops that strengthen and

780081:
[Facilities]

780082:

780084:
[Assigning Crew]

{8081:07}Crew thawed from cold sleep{/color} can be

780085:
[Class Counter]

At the Class Counter, you can customize

[Learning Gran Arts and Techniques]

Gran Arts are enhanced attacks set on a

Hunters and Rangers need the skill

everyone.

780089:

clearing quests{/color}.

A weapon can hold {8081:07}up to 4{/color} Attach Parts.
780093:
[Making Armor]

Making armor (Shield Units) {8081:07}requires

780094:
[Item Shop]

{8081:07}Create items from materials{/color} here.

780095:
[Costume Shop]

{8081:07}Create costumes from materials{/color} here.

You can {8081:07}change costumes at the Salon{/color}.

Costumes do not affect defense.
780096:
[Salon]

At the Salon, you can {8081:07}change your
appearance and costume, and set your
personality and traits{/color}.

Raising the Salon's level and assigning crew
adds more edit menus and options, allowing
finer and more varied customization.
780097:
[Style]

Your Style is {8081:07}shown when other players
you played multiplayer with call up your

Choose a Style that suits your character.
780098:
[Traits]

Traits {8081:07}affect your character's abilities

multiplayer with call it up as "Guest Crew"{/color}.

Choose Traits that suit your character.
780099:
[Storage]

You can {8081:07}deposit items in Storage freely.{/color}

{8081:07}If you get more of an item than its carry

780100:
[Caution When Saving]

A save icon appears in the upper right
of the screen while saving.

{8081:07}While saving, do not insert or remove the
memory card or turn off the PlayStation®Vita
system.{/color}

Doing so may corrupt your save data.
780101:
[Main Menu]

Press {8099:09} to open the Main Menu.

In the Main Menu, you can {8081:07}organize and
equip items, check your progress, save,
and more.{/color}
780102:
[Promise Orders]

{8081:07}Making promises with people at the base{/color}

above their heads{/color}.

When you meet a promise's terms, talk to the
person and {8081:07}report from the promise list{/color}.

it produced and a thank-you gift from them.

{8081:03}*Except one-time promises{/color}
780104:
Fulfilling Promise Orders from Captain Fildia
adds new facilities and shops.

Actively complete Fildia's requests to
expand your base.
780105:
You have become captain of the Delta Variant,
entrusted with leading its many crew members.

In "Grand Act II," you can survey the planet
and expand your base to fight planet-sized
Gigantes.

Show your skill as captain and lead your crew.
780106:
[Gran Booster]

The Gran Booster is a device that excites
Gran.

It can {8081:07}increase the Gran Energy{/color} you get
in quests and {8081:07}reduce Gran Arts costs{/color}.

Assigning crew with the Gran Forecaster trait

780107:
[Item Detector]

The Item Detector is a device that helps you
find items.

to obtain.{/color}

Crew with the Dowsinger or Luckyriser trait

780108:
[Enemy Radar]

The Enemy Radar is a device that tracks

easier to find.{/color}

Crew with the "Wild Instinct" trait make it
more effective when assigned.
780109:
[Burst Accelerator]

The Burst Accelerator is a device that

Bursts triggered by Chains{/color}.
780110:
[Expeditions]

At Expeditions, you can {8081:07}send crew out to

{8081:07}Going on quests makes days pass, and when

[Fatigued Crew]

Crew sent exploring may become fatigued.

780112:

[Gigantes Blast]

[Activating Gigantes Blast]

780115:
[Theater Scope]

In the Theater Scope, you can replay events
you have experienced so far.
780116:
At the Class Counter, you can customize your
abilities.

{8081:07}Skills learned on leveling up take effect
once set on the "Skill Board" at the Class
Counter.{/color}

Counter first.
780117:
You take over as captain and continue the
planetary exploration mission.

{8081:07}You can now use "Develop Facilities" and
"Place/Move Facilities" at the Lab.{/color}
780118:
{8081:07}The base's upper level is now open{/color}.

780119:
{8081:07}The base's lower level is now open{/color}.

Access it from the lower level entrance.
780120:
Fildia is on the {8081:07}Bridge{/color}.

Variant's entrance.
780121:
Your assistant Sharon is at the {8081:07}Lab{/color}

780122:
Choose a quest at the {8081:07}Quest Gate on the edge

780123:
The {8081:07}Cold Sleep Room{/color} can be reached through

780124:
The {8081:07}Multiplayer Room{/color} can be reached through

780125:

to an end for now, but you can turn back

780126:

780127:

780128:
If you obtain items while storage is over its
{8081:07}2000-item limit{/color}, they {8081:07}automatically go to

Armor has three types of defense.

S-DEF:
Affects damage taken from melee attacks.

R-DEF:
Affects damage taken from ranged attacks.

T-DEF:
Affects damage taken from technique attacks.

Attach an elemental Attach Part to a weapon
to give it an element.

There are six elements: Fire, Ice, Lightning,
Wind, Light, and Dark. Weapons of an enemy's
{8081:07}weak element{/color} deal greater damage.

elemental damage.

ARKS Special Planetary Exploration Team,
"Alter". I'm Rietheia, medical staff.
100010020050008:
Let's check to ensure that your memory
is in working order.

You are the newest member of "Alter". We are heading for the newly
discovered planet, Makhia.

until we've arrived.

warp to unexplored planets, so most personnel
remain in Cold Sleep until arrival.
100010020130008:
Once we enter Makhia's orbit, the primary
exploration team, including combat personnel,
may then safely descend to the surface.
100010020140008:
And you've been chosen for the primary
exploration team.

Your memory appears to be fine! Please
proceed to your physical checkup and
promptly to briefing.

You certainly won't.

100010020190008: There seems to be no problems, right?
100010020200008:
Nothing to worry about. Everything
looks good to me!
100010020210008:
Every once in a while, the process doesn't
go right, and....
100010020220008:
A-anyway, the point is that you made it
safe and sound!
100010020230008:
Did I scare you? Good! I was checking on
your emotions. It seems they are in order.

Well then! Please proceed to the training
room.

and ensure your muscles haven't atrophied.
Uh...break a leg!

A lot of rookies get it wrong....
